title: OversightProof oversight receipt
description: Offline-verifiable anchor of the existence, time, and immutability of an evidence dossier. Advisory evidence, not legal advice and not a compliance determination.

commitment.description: The salted commitment to the dossier root. The raw root and the salt stay local and never appear here.

metadata.description: Allowlisted, non-PII metadata only. No decision data, reviewer identities, or review content.

anchors.description: One or more independent anchor proofs over the salted commitment (multi-anchor, no sole authority).

claims.description: The advisory statement embedded verbatim in every receipt (not legal advice and not a compliance determination).
